plannedSlices.summary: Every town tavern and Wayfarer Lodge draws its own weekly pair from every faction's free heroes (own faction 20:1); human and AI hire from them; the lodge's four-hero limit is gone. Six capped XL seeds decided, leaders up to 43 heroes.

AiSeatRules is native (ai_seat_rules.cpp), one copy with match_sim_cli; the unused field-transfer list and its test are deleted; create_session and the authored browser wait for the scenario rework. Six seeds identical to main.

plannedSlices.title: AI field armies concentrate into the main army; boxed-in main armies call for help; unseen rivals worth hunting
plannedSlices.goal: Owner 2026-10-28: play to eliminate. In: heroes scale with towns (no hero_count_max) and a player short of heroes keeps the hire's gold from town spending; a hostile hero worth every town it threatens, on either level; no baseline garrison; field armies join only on a shortfall (no FIELD_SHARE_MAX); scouting grows with the day; taverns of every faction. Six capped seeds of the 600-game XL batch end on days 207-320, leaders with up to 43 heroes. Left: a leader still finishes slowly; raiders take emptied towns (1,004 of 2,462 captures in those six).
